sourceText: User instructed us to continue B-1fa6 until DONE, stated the work is only a document audit, and classified failures affecting REVIEW/TEST/DONE gates as non-deferrable. The mandatory validation then independently failed on main because the retired-authority dynamic binding budget was 800 while current main measured 804.
normalizedOutcome: The baseline validation blocker is repaired in an independent Story, while B-1fa6 remains document-only and can continue to TEST.
acceptanceClaim: At a committed B-5952 green HEAD, the rebuilt retired-authority vocabulary smoke exits 0 under a finite ceiling no greater than 850, and B-1fa6 Dynamic Finding document has no B-5952 diff.
